; ========================================================================
; EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
; ========================================================================
;
; HANGMAN.PDM is a word-guessing game for 1-4 players. The player
; guesses letters to reveal a hidden word; wrong guesses draw parts
; of a hangman figure. Features include save/restore, player score
; tracking, configurable difficulty (words per game, max wrong guesses),
; and a profanity-safe word list.
;
; Self-contained: no DM89 imports (word list is embedded in binary).
; Uses DeskMate API (INT E0h) for UI framework, file I/O, and cursor
; management. Loads PRGUF, DMGUF, DMCSR, and SPELL resources at runtime
; via INT E0h AX=0206h.
;
; ========================================================================
; BINARY STRUCTURE
; ========================================================================
;
; MZ + DM89 header (512 bytes)
; DM89 entry point: 0447:0006 (MSC 5.x CRT startup)
; SS:SP = 0F39:0800
;
; Segment Map (4 segments, 13 relocations):
;   seg_0000  0x4470 bytes  CODE   Main game code + CRT library (17,520 bytes)
;   seg_0447  0x00B0 bytes  CODE   MSC 5.x CRT startup + far-call stubs
;   seg_0452  0x0040 bytes  DATA   DGROUP fixup area
;   seg_0456  0x2233 bytes  DATA   Strings, menus, hangman graphics,
;                                  word list index, packed word data
;
; Medium memory model: multiple code segments (0000 + 0447), DGROUP at 0452.
;

; Packed word data at 0456:1572 (3,265 bytes):
;   Binary-encoded word list using a compact encoding scheme.
;   Words are read character-by-character via sub_0000_23EB which
;   calls sub_0000_3369 (read byte) and sub_0000_348E (get next item).
;   The encoding appears to be a byte-stream with record separators
;   (0x0D = carriage return as word delimiter).
;
; Word selection (sub_0000_152F):
;   1. Calls DeskMate API (sub_0000_1564 with 0xFD17) to check
;      if external word source is available
;   2. If yes: reads word from DMSPELL resource (sub_0000_23EB)
;   3. If no: uses sub_0000_42D2 (_rand) to generate random index,
;      divides by 6 to select from 6 difficulty levels (categories 4-9)
;
; ========================================================================
; PROFANITY FILTER
; ========================================================================
;
; The profanity filter is implemented via the SPELL resource module:
;   - sub_0000_3597 (hang_loadSpell): Loads SPELL via INT E0h AX=0206h
;   - sub_0000_35B9 (hang_callSpell): Calls SPELL to check word
;   - Referenced at 0000:00E0: if spell resource available, call it
;     on startup to validate word list
;
; The SPELL resource (loaded from SPELL.RES or DMSPELL.RES) provides
; dictionary lookup that can filter inappropriate words. The game
; checks [0xF08] flag to determine if spell-checking is available.
;
; ========================================================================
; HANGMAN FIGURE GRAPHICS
; ========================================================================
;
; The data segment (0456:0380-0x0B40) contains coordinate data for
; drawing the hangman figure. Each body part (head, body, arms, legs,
; face features) is defined as a series of coordinate pairs for
; line drawing via the DeskMate graphics API.
;
; The figure is drawn progressively with each wrong guess, with
; up to 10 stages (configurable via "Wrong Guesses" setting):
;   Stage 1: Gallows frame
;   Stage 2: Head (circle)
;   Stage 3: Body
;   Stage 4: Left arm
;   Stage 5: Right arm
;   Stage 6: Left leg
;   Stage 7: Right leg
;   Stage 8-10: Face features (eyes, nose, mouth)
;
; ========================================================================
; MENU STRUCTURE
; ========================================================================
;
; Menu bar:
;   "Game"     -> "New", "Save", "Restore", "Exit    Esc"
;   "Run ..."  -> Execute/run submenu
;   "About ..." -> Version/copyright dialog
;   "Players"  -> "Define...", "Add...", "Delete..."
;
; Dialogs:
;   "Define Game"     - Number of players, words per game, wrong guesses
;   "Add Player"      - "New player name:" text input
;   "Delete Player"   - "Choose player to delete:" selection
;   "Define Players"  - Player 1-4 name configuration
;
; Status display:
;   "SCOREBOARD" header
;   "CURRENT GAME" header
;   "Player       Words Guessed     Score" column headers
;   Current player/word/guess count display
;
; Game messages:
;   "The letter % has already been guessed.  Try a different letter!"
;   "Please wait while a word is chosen..."
;   "YOU'VE BEEN PARDONED!" (won)
;   " HANGED!" (lost)
;   "Would you like to play again?"
;   "Would you like to save this game before quitting?"
;   "A previous game was saved.  Would you like to continue..."
;

; PROGRAM FLOW
; ========================================================================
;
; 1. CRT startup (0447:0006)
;    a. DOS version check, stack/memory setup, BSS clear
;    b. _cinit, _setargv, _setenvp
;
; 2. _main (0000:0010):
;    a. hang_init (0000:001F):
;       - Load DeskMate resources (PRGUF, DMGUF, DMCSR, SPELL)
;       - Initialize window and menu bar
;       - Load HANGMAN.CFG configuration
;    b. If saved game exists (return == 0xFFFE):
;       - hang_gameLoop (0000:0737): restore and continue saved game
;    c. hang_cleanup (0000:00BF):
;       - Display final scoreboard
;       - Set timeout, save config
;       - Check if SPELL resource loaded; if so, call it
;       - Unload all resources
;       - Call _exit(0)
;
; 3. Game Loop (hang_gameLoop, 0000:0737):
;    a. For each word (up to words_per_game):
;       - hang_chooseWord (0000:152F): select word from list
;       - hang_playRound (0000:0795): play one word
;    b. After all words:
;       - Show scoreboard
;       - "Would you like to play again?"
;       - If yes: reset and loop; if no: offer to save, exit
;
; 4. Round Play (hang_playRound, 0000:0795):
;    a. Display blank word (dots/underscores)
;    b. Wait for keyboard input (letter guess)
;    c. Check if letter already guessed
;    d. If in word: reveal all instances
;    e. If not in word: increment wrong count, draw hangman part
;    f. Check win condition (all letters revealed -> "PARDONED!")
;    g. Check lose condition (max wrong -> "HANGED!")
;    h. Update score
;
